pages.title: Balance Bonus
pages.text:
When all six food groups are above their threshold, you gain the $(#52c252)Balance Bonus$() — a persistent buff that improves health, speed, or other stats depending on your configuration.

Keeping the bonus active should be your primary goal.

pages.title: Per-Group Bonuses
pages.text:
Each food group has its own bonus active when healthy:

$(bold)Fruits$() — increased regeneration speed.
$(bold)Vegetables$() — improved hunger saturation.
$(bold)Proteins$() — increased max health.
$(bold)Grains$() — faster experience gain.
$(bold)Sugars$() — increased jump height.
$(bold)Dairy$() — increased armor toughness.

pages.title: Penalties
pages.text:
Letting any group fall to zero applies a $(#e05252)penalty$() for that group. Penalties stack — neglecting multiple groups at once causes increasingly severe debuffs.

Recovery is straightforward: eat foods from the depleted group and the penalty fades as the bar refills.

pages.title: Per-Group Penalties
pages.text:
Each food group has its own penalty when depleted:

$(bold)Fruits$() — reduced max health.
$(bold)Vegetables$() — reduced movement speed.
$(bold)Proteins$() — reduced attack damage.
$(bold)Grains$() — reduced hunger restoration.
$(bold)Sugars$() — reduced sprint speed.
$(bold)Dairy$() — reduced knockback resistance.

pages.title: Stacking Effects
pages.text:
Effects from multiple groups stack. Having all six bonuses active simultaneously gives a compound advantage across health, damage, speed, regen, XP, and armor.

Conversely, multiple penalties at once — especially Fruits (health) + Proteins (damage) + Dairy (knockback) — can make combat very dangerous. Prioritize preventing that combination above all else.

pages.title: Viewing Active Effects
pages.text:
Your currently active Nourished bonuses and penalties are shown on the left panel of the $(bold)Diet Screen$(). Open it to see a full list of current effects and which groups are causing them.

The HUD bar overlay gives a quick at-a-glance view of bar levels in the game world without opening any screen.
